question: What ancestral destination is attained through śrāddha at the Akṣayavaṭa site?
premises: The performer effects the rite for ancestors.
The rite leads ancestors to the world of Brahmā.
inference: Performing śrāddha at Akṣayavaṭa leads the ancestors to the world of Brahmā.
plain_english: Likewise, one performing śrāddha at the imperishable banyan leads the ancestors to the world of Brahmā.
